source_chain.detail: Before this change IO applied only kotlin.multiplatform and module.publication, while exposing calfCore. The original IO test import-object.mjs contains './skiko.mjs'.

Core already uses compose.multiplatform and declares Compose foundation. Its public/core runtime dependency route brings Compose/Skiko into the IO runtime; this receipt does not execute a fresh dependency-resolution graph.
The plain KMP convention configures targets/tests/ABI but does not apply org.jetbrains.compose or the Compose web runtime task wiring.

The existing Compose convention applies the KMP convention, org.jetbrains.compose and Kotlin Compose compiler, then configures browser executables and keeps executable/test checks for modules with real sources.
Real common/web IO test sources make configureBrowserTestBundles call withBrowserTestBundling. The existing source-aware UI check is retained; no check is suppressed by this change.
withBrowserTestBundling declares JS and Wasm executables; documented side effect is webpack distributions in assemble. No publication dependency or version is edited.

cmp_bytecode_chain.detail: Registers the afterEvaluate callback; apply$lambda$2 invokes ConfigureWebApplicationKt.configureWeb at offset15.
Collects selected web targets and calls configureWebApplication when nonempty.
Defines unpacked/processed Skiko output directories, registers unpackSkikoWasmRuntime and processSkikoRuntimeForKWasm, and configures each target's compilations plus the UI-test executable check.
For a Wasm target, visits every compilation binary, including the test executable. Its lambda14 obtains getLinkSyncTask (offset1) and configures it (offset16).

Adds dependsOn(processed runtime task) at11 and from(processed runtime directory) at29 to DefaultIncrementalSyncTask. This is the relevant Wasm test executable-copy relationship; ProcessResources alone is not the Wasm mechanism.
The separate non-Wasm JS branch adds the unpacked runtime to ProcessResources and its task dependency. JS behavior still requires actual regression verification.
